_comment: The aspect ratio each image surface renders at, as width/height. Read by BOTH the renderer (domain/image_crop.py) and the builder's cropper (ImageUploadField), because the cropper must frame exactly what the page will show -- a cropper locked to a different ratio than the renderer crops to is worse than no cropper, since the tenant's framing is silently discarded. Adding a surface here is what makes it croppable. See plans/IMAGE_CROPPER.md.
